# signature-scheme-lab

> Compare byte budgets for Ed25519, secp256k1, BLS, and one-time signatures.

signature-scheme-lab is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/signature-scheme-lab/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
